facts.fact: KNBS publishes the second Kenya Strategy for Development of Statistics (KSDS II) for 2023/24-2027/28 for download as the national statistical system strategy; no adoption date is given, so the document's published date is used.
The first Kenya Strategy for Development of Statistics (KSDS I) was developed and implemented for 2019/20-2022/23, a period that has ended; KSDS II followed it.
KSDS I was evaluated in 2023, with document reviews, stakeholder consultations and risk analyses, and the evaluation informed the development of KSDS II.

note: Regional strategy RSDS II 2026-2030 adopted; states nothing of this country's national strategy.
Senate committee review of the draft Statistics Bill 2026; says nothing about a national statistics strategy.
Sector plan for gender statistics only; the document does not mention a national strategy.
Bill text passages (arrangement of clauses); no national statistics strategy stated.
Statistics Act 2006 states no national statistics strategy; statistics law is not a strategy.

facts.fact: PARIS21's January 2026 NSDS status table lists the strategy as implementing (adopted): KSDS 2023-2028.
